reasons.claim: 0.59 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified. Completed felling overlap is 0.3%, so not already felled.

Two eligible species recorded within 250 m: Alectoria sarmentosa (VU lichen; records from 2018 at 101 m and 2024 at 173 m with 5 m uncertainty) and Skeletocutis brevispora (VU fungus; 2018, 101 m, 250 m uncertainty). Both are site-bound and forest-associated, with felling-relevant threats (lack of continuity forest, old trees, dead wood; ground disturbance in forestry).

Three site-bound forest NT species are also within 250 m: Hermanssonia centrifuga (97 m, 2024, 5 m uncertainty), Bryoria nadvornikiana and Phellinidium ferrugineofuscum. They are supporting evidence only.
Recording effort is adequate: 95 records and 56 species within 1000 m versus county median 66 (64th percentile). 8 records within 250 m, none inside the polygon.

uncertainties: The 2018 VU records have 250 m uncertainty, much larger than the site's 43 m equivalent radius, so their exact position relative to the polygon is unclear.
The 2024 Alectoria sarmentosa record (173 m, 5 m uncertainty) is precise and recent but still lies outside the polygon.
not_established: It is not established that any listed species occupies the polygon now.
No records inside the polygon, so occupancy of the felling site is not shown.
Red List categories describe extinction risk, not legal protection.
next_action: Human ecologist should review before felling begins, with a field check for the lichens and wood fungi recorded 97-173 m away. The neighbouring notification A 40218-2026 is near the same records and could be reviewed together.
